Coram : M.Y. EQBAL*, C. NAGAPPAN
A B Constitution of India, 1950: Article 142 - Invocation of power under-For waiving the cooling off period of 6 months c for filing second motion uls. 13-B of the Hindu Marriage Act - Held: In the instant case, Family Court had made necessary efforts for reconciliation between the parties but leave India for job purpose and it was not possible for him to D return back in a year or two and, therefore, she would suffer mental agony and would also not be able to remarry- It is a fit case where in order to do complete justice to the parties, it is necessary to invoke the power u!Art. 142
